trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Speeds up emulation so that the guest refresh rate matches the host. This results in the smoothest animations possible, at the cost of potentially increasing the emulation speed by less than 1%. Sync to Host Refresh Rate will not take effect if the console{[=-apos;-=]}s refresh rate is too far from the host{[=-apos;-=]}s refresh rate. Users with variable refresh rate displays should disable this option.']
trans-unit.source: Speeds up emulation so that the guest refresh rate matches the host. This results in the smoothest animations possible, at the cost of potentially increasing the emulation speed by less than 1%. Sync to Host Refresh Rate will not take effect if the console's refresh rate is too far from the host's refresh rate. Users with variable refresh rate displays should disable this option.
trans-unit.target: Snabbar upp emuleringen så att gästsystemets uppdateringsfrekvens motsvarar värdens. Det ger så mjuka animationer som möjligt, men emuleringshastigheten kan då öka med mindre än 1 %. Synkronisering med värdens uppdateringsfrekvens har ingen effekt om konsolens uppdateringsfrekvens avviker för mycket från värdens. Användare med skärmar med variabel uppdateringsfrekvens bör inaktivera alternativet.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['When synchronizing with the host refresh rate, this option disables PCSX2{[=-apos;-=]}s internal frame timing and uses the host instead. Can result in smoother frame pacing, {[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}but at the cost of increased input latency{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}.']
trans-unit.source: When synchronizing with the host refresh rate, this option disables PCSX2's internal frame timing and uses the host instead. Can result in smoother frame pacing, <strong>but at the cost of increased input latency</strong>.
trans-unit.target: När du synkroniserar med värdens uppdateringsfrekvens använder alternativet värdens bildrutetakt i stället för PCSX2:s interna. Det kan ge jämnare bildrutetakt, <strong>men på bekostnad av ökad inmatningsfördröjning</strong>.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Detects when idle frames are being presented in 25/30fps games, and skips presenting those frames. The frame is still rendered, it just means the GPU has more time to complete it (this is NOT frame skipping). Can smooth out frame time fluctuations when the CPU/GPU are near maximum utilization, but makes frame pacing more inconsistent and can increase input lag. Helps when using frame generation on 25/30fps games.']
trans-unit.source: Detects when idle frames are being presented in 25/30fps games, and skips presenting those frames. The frame is still rendered, it just means the GPU has more time to complete it (this is NOT frame skipping). Can smooth out frame time fluctuations when the CPU/GPU are near maximum utilization, but makes frame pacing more inconsistent and can increase input lag. Helps when using frame generation on 25/30fps games.
trans-unit.target: Identifierar vilande bildrutor som visas i spel med 25 eller 30 bilder/s och hoppar över att visa dem. Bildrutorna renderas fortfarande, men GPU:n får mer tid att slutföra dem. Det här är inte bildrutehoppning. Funktionen kan jämna ut variationer i bildrutetiden när CPU:n eller GPU:n är nära maximal belastning, men gör bildrutetakten mindre jämn och kan öka inmatningsfördröjningen. Den hjälper vid bildrutegenerering i spel med 25 eller 30 bilder/s.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Manually set a real-time clock to use for the virtual PlayStation 2 instead of using your OS{[=-apos;-=]} system clock.']
trans-unit.source: Manually set a real-time clock to use for the virtual PlayStation 2 instead of using your OS' system clock.
trans-unit.target: Ange manuellt den realtidsklocka som den virtuella PlayStation 2 ska använda i stället för operativsystemets systemklocka.
